set.body:
Source: compressed review finding on scontrol spaced-value parsing and remaining parser seams.

Problem:
space-delimited key/value parsing can split legitimate values and a malformed/unknown row can erase otherwise usable scheduler evidence.

Acceptance:
- Parse scontrol output with a grammar aware of keys and values that may contain spaces or delimiters.
- Preserve unknown fields and bounded raw evidence without promoting them to authority.
- Isolate malformed rows/fields wherever the command contract permits partial success.
- Add provenance-stamped fixtures for spaced values, unknown states/reasons, empty fields, non-ASCII text, and mixed-good/bad records.
set.title: P6f.16: Harden scontrol and remaining Slurm text parsers
